P2D0F.title: Engine Pre-Ignition Above Threshold
P2D0F.description: The ECM detects pre-ignition events (combustion before spark) above the calibrated threshold. Risk of severe engine damage from uncontrolled combustion peaks.

causes.label: Carbon deposits glow as hot spots

P2D10.title: Engine Pre-Ignition Above Threshold - Forced Limited Power
P2D10.description: Pre-ignition events exceed a critical threshold. The ECM forces limited engine power to protect pistons, rings, and connecting rods from further damage.

causes.label: Low-octane fuel under sustained high load
Carbon deposits glow as hot spots

P2D11.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve A Position Not Learned
P2D11.description: The ECM has not learned the end-stop calibration for exhaust flow control valve A. Position cannot be commanded with full precision until adaptation completes.

causes.label: Adaptation lost after battery disconnect or ECM reset

P2D12.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve B Position Not Learned
P2D12.description: The ECM has not learned the end-stop calibration for exhaust flow control valve B. Position cannot be commanded with full precision until adaptation completes.

causes.label: Adaptation lost after battery disconnect or ECM reset

P2D13.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Control Circuit/Open
P2D13.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a control circuit/open condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body

P2D14.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Control Circuit Low
P2D14.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a control circuit low condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2D15.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Control Circuit High
P2D15.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a control circuit high condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2D16.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Control Performance
P2D16.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a control performance condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

P2D17.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Position Circuit
P2D17.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a position circuit condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

P2D18.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Position Circuit Range/Performance
P2D18.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a position circuit range/performance condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Linkage between sensor and valve loose
Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2D19.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Position Circuit Low
P2D19.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a position circuit low condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2D1B.title: Exhaust Flow Control Valve C Position Not Learned
P2D1B.description: The exhaust flow control valve C reports a position not learned condition. Exhaust routing for back-pressure or noise control on this branch cannot be commanded reliably.

P2D1C.title: Cold Start EGR A/B Ratio Performance
P2D1C.description: During cold start, the ratio between EGR channel A and B flow does not match the calibrated cold-start strategy. One channel responds slower or sticks at low temperature.

causes.label: One EGR valve sluggish at cold

P2D1D.title: Reductant System Leak Detected – Small Leak
P2D1D.description: The SCR module detects a small leak in the reductant system based on pressure decay rate after dosing pause. Slow loss of DEF/AdBlue.

causes.label: Seal aged at injector or pump

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

P2D1E.title: Reductant System Leak Detected – Large Leak
P2D1E.description: The SCR module detects a large leak in the reductant system. Pressure cannot be maintained for dosing operations.

causes.label: Reductant supply line disconnected or split

symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

P2D1F.title: Reductant System Flow – Restricted
P2D1F.description: The SCR module detects restricted flow in the reductant system. Pressure rises above expected for the commanded dosing rate.
symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

P2D20.title: Reductant System Flow – Blocked
P2D20.description: The SCR module detects fully blocked flow in the reductant system. No reductant reaches the injector despite commanded dosing.
symptoms: Check engine light or NOx warning on
Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

P2D21.title: Turbocharger Interstage Pressure Sensor A Circuit
P2D21.description: The ECM detects a circuit fault on the turbocharger interstage pressure sensor a circuit. Reading cannot be used reliably for control.
symptoms: Possible blue or black smoke from exhaust
Whistling or hissing sound from intake

P2D22.title: Turbocharger Interstage Pressure Sensor A Circuit Range/Performance

P2D26.title: Coolant Pump E Control Circuit Performance/Stuck Off
P2D26.description: Coolant pump E is commanded on but does not respond as expected. Pump motor stuck, relay weld, or driver fault.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P2D27.title: Coolant Pump F Control Circuit Performance/Stuck Off
P2D27.description: Coolant pump F is commanded on but does not respond as expected. Pump motor stuck, relay weld, or driver fault.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P2D28.title: Cold Start Propulsion Torque Performance
P2D28.description: During cold start, the propulsion torque output does not match the calibrated cold-start torque profile. Cold engine response, hybrid blend, or torque modelling deviates from expected.

P2D29.title: A/C Compressor Motor Stalled
P2D29.description: The electric A/C compressor motor is stalled. High mechanical resistance, internal seizure, or refrigerant overpressure prevents rotation.

P2D2A.title: Hybrid/EV Electronics Coolant Temperature Sensor A/B Correlation
P2D2A.description: The signals of the hybrid electronics coolant temperature sensors A and B do not correlate within the calibrated tolerance. One sensor drifts or installation offset between channels.

P2D2B.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Coolant Temperature Sensor A/B Correlation
P2D2B.description: The signals of the HV battery pack coolant temperature sensors A and B do not correlate within the calibrated tolerance. One sensor drifts or installation offset between channels.

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D2C.title: Engine Coolant Temperature Measurement System - Multiple Sensor Correlation
P2D2C.description: The signals of multiple engine coolant temperature sensors do not correlate within the calibrated tolerance. One sensor drifts or installation offset between channels.
symptoms: Cooling fan runs constantly or not at all
Cabin heater weak or excessively hot
Possible long warm-up time or hard cold start

P2D2D.title: Cold Start Intake Manifold Runner Performance Bank 1
P2D2D.description: During cold start, the intake manifold runner control on bank 1 does not produce the expected tumble/swirl effect. Linkage stiff, actuator sluggish, or runner alignment off.

P2D2E.title: Cold Start Intake Manifold Runner Performance Bank 2
P2D2E.description: During cold start, the intake manifold runner control on bank 2 does not produce the expected tumble/swirl effect. Linkage stiff, actuator sluggish, or runner alignment off.

P2D2F.title: Cold Start Turbocharger/Supercharger A Underboost
P2D2F.description: During cold start, turbocharger/supercharger A does not produce the expected boost pressure. Cold lubricant, lazy wastegate, or turbine spool-up delayed.
symptoms: Possible blue or black smoke from exhaust
Whistling or hissing sound from intake

P2D30.title: Cold Start Turbocharger/Supercharger A Overboost
P2D30.description: During cold start, turbocharger/supercharger A produces boost pressure above the cold-start target. Wastegate sticking closed or boost control overshoot.
symptoms: Possible blue or black smoke from exhaust
Whistling or hissing sound from intake

P2D31.title: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Exceeded Learning Limit Bank 1
P2D31.description: The required adaptation offset for the intake manifold tuning valve on bank 1 exceeds the calibrated learning window. Mechanism wear or sensor drift beyond compensation.

P2D32.title: Intake Manifold Tuning Valve Control Circuit Driver Current/Temperature Too High Bank 1
P2D32.description: The output driver for the intake manifold tuning valve actuator on bank 1 reports current or junction temperature above its protection threshold.

P2D33.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Inductive Charger Control Module Processor Performance
P2D33.description: The hybrid battery inductive charger control module reports a processor performance fault. Internal self-tests fail or response time outside calibration.

causes.label: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D34.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Inductive Charger Control Circuit Range/Performance
P2D34.description: The hybrid battery inductive charger control circuit reports a range/performance condition. Charger response or feedback outside calibration.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D35.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Inductive Charging System High Voltage Interlock Circuit Performance

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D36.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Inductive Charger Output Voltage Performance
P2D36.description: The output voltage of the inductive charger does not match the commanded value within tolerance. Air-gap variation, load mismatch, or coil aging.

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D37.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Inductive Charger Input Circuit Range/Performance

P2D38.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Pack Heater Performance

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D39.title: Forced Hybrid/EV Battery Disconnect
P2D39.description: The BMS has forced a disconnect of the high-voltage battery from the vehicle bus. Triggered by safety condition such as overcurrent, isolation fault, or thermal runaway.

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D3A.title: Forced Hybrid/EV System Shutdown
P2D3A.description: The hybrid control module has forced a complete system shutdown. Triggered by critical fault such as multiple isolation warnings or contactor failure.

P2D3B.title: Hybrid/EV Discharge System Fault
P2D3B.description: The hybrid control module detects a fault in the active discharge system used to safely drain the DC-link capacitors after shutdown. Discharge resistor or switch may have failed.

P2D3C.title: Cold Start Hybrid/EV Drive Motor Performance
P2D3C.description: During cold start, the hybrid drive motor does not deliver the expected torque or speed. Cold lubricant viscosity or magnet temperature affects motor characteristic.
symptoms: Possible limp mode or vehicle shutdown

P2D3D.title: Cold Start Hybrid/EV Drive Motor Inverter Torque Performance
P2D3D.description: During cold start, the inverter cannot deliver commanded torque to the drive motor within the expected window. Cold capacitor characteristic or switching loss elevated.
symptoms: Possible limp mode or vehicle shutdown

P2D3E.title: Cold Start Hybrid/EV Battery Performance
P2D3E.description: During cold start, the HV battery cannot deliver the expected power. Cold cell impedance reduces available current.

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D3F.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Cooling System B Performance
P2D3F.description: The hybrid battery cooling system B does not maintain target temperatures under load. Coolant flow, radiator fouling, or pump output reduced on this branch.

causes.label: Radiator fins fouled - reduced heat rejection
Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2D41.title: A/C Compressor Motor Voltage B Performance
P2D41.description: The voltage B feedback of the electric A/C compressor motor does not match the commanded value within tolerance.

P2D42.title: A/C Compressor Motor Voltage B Low
P2D42.description: The voltage B feedback of the electric A/C compressor motor is below the expected window. Phase wire shorted to ground or driver fault.

causes.label: Phase B wire shorted to ground

P2D43.title: A/C Compressor Motor Voltage B High
P2D43.description: The voltage B feedback of the electric A/C compressor motor is above the expected window. Phase wire shorted to B+ or driver fault.

causes.label: Phase B wire shorted to B+

P2D44.title: A/C Compressor Motor Performance
P2D44.description: The electric A/C compressor motor does not deliver the expected speed or torque for the commanded duty. Bearing wear, magnet aging, or load mismatch.

P2D45.title: Reductant Temperature Too Low
P2D45.description: The reductant temperature is below the calibrated minimum. DEF/AdBlue may not flow correctly through the dosing system - heater fault or extreme cold weather.

Possible no-start countdown after ignore period

P2DE4.description: The drive motor A clutch cannot leave the engaged state when release is commanded. The drive motor's position, current and temperature are watched continuously; a fault here downgrades the inverter to a safe operating point or triggers torque reduction.
symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Possible limp mode (locked in one gear)
Slipping or shuddering during gear changes

P2DE5.title: Drive Motor A Clutch Stuck Disengaged
P2DE5.description: The drive motor A clutch cannot leave the disengaged state when engagement is commanded. The drive motor's position, current and temperature are watched continuously; a fault here downgrades the inverter to a safe operating point or triggers torque reduction.
symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Possible limp mode (locked in one gear)
Slipping or shuddering during gear changes

P2DE6.title: Drive Motor A Clutch Actuator Performance
P2DE6.description: The drive motor A clutch actuator does not respond within the calibrated time window. The drive motor's position, current and temperature are watched continuously; a fault here downgrades the inverter to a safe operating point or triggers torque reduction.
symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Possible limp mode (locked in one gear)
Slipping or shuddering during gear changes

P2DE7.title: Cold Start Engine Coolant Bypass Valve C Range/Performance
P2DE7.description: During cold start, the engine coolant bypass valve C response does not match the cold-start calibration.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DE8.title: Cold Start Engine Coolant Bypass Valve D Stuck Open
P2DE8.description: During cold start, the engine coolant bypass valve D is stuck in the open position. Coolant bypasses the warm-up loop.

causes.label: Carbon or debris buildup preventing free movement

P2DE9.title: Cold Start Engine Coolant Pump Underspeed
P2DE9.description: During cold start, the engine coolant pump runs below the calibrated minimum speed. Cold viscosity load too high or pump weak.

P2DEA.title: Cylinder 1 Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance
P2DEA.description: The variable intake valve lift on cylinder 1 does not reach the commanded position within tolerance. Mechanism wear or actuator force degraded.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DEB.title: Cylinder 2 Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance
P2DEB.description: The variable intake valve lift on cylinder 2 does not reach the commanded position within tolerance. Mechanism wear or actuator force degraded.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DEC.title: Cylinder 3 Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance
P2DEC.description: The variable intake valve lift on cylinder 3 does not reach the commanded position within tolerance. Mechanism wear or actuator force degraded.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DED.title: Cylinder 4 Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance
P2DED.description: The variable intake valve lift on cylinder 4 does not reach the commanded position within tolerance. Mechanism wear or actuator force degraded.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DEE.title: Cylinder 5 Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance
P2DEE.description: The variable intake valve lift on cylinder 5 does not reach the commanded position within tolerance. Mechanism wear or actuator force degraded.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DEF.title: Cylinder 6 Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance
P2DEF.description: The variable intake valve lift on cylinder 6 does not reach the commanded position within tolerance. Mechanism wear or actuator force degraded.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DF0.title: Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance Bank 1
P2DF0.description: The variable intake valve lift system reports range/performance fault on bank 1. Multiple cylinders or system-wide deviation.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DF1.title: Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance Bank 2
P2DF1.description: The variable intake valve lift system reports range/performance fault on bank 2. Multiple cylinders or system-wide deviation.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DF2.title: Intake Valve Lift Range/Performance System
P2DF2.description: The variable intake valve lift system reports range/performance fault on system. Multiple cylinders or system-wide deviation.

causes.label: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

P2DF3.title: Engine Disconnect Clutch Actuator Position Not Learned
P2DF3.description: The hybrid control module has not learned the end-stop calibration for the engine disconnect clutch actuator.
symptoms: Check engine or transmission warning light on
Possible limp mode (locked in one gear)
Slipping or shuddering during gear changes

P2DF4.title: Coolant Pump E Control Circuit/Open
P2DF4.description: Coolant pump E reports a control circuit/open condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body

P2DF5.title: Coolant Pump E Control Circuit Low
P2DF5.description: Coolant pump E reports a control circuit low condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2DF6.title: Coolant Pump E Control Circuit High
P2DF6.description: Coolant pump E reports a control circuit high condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

causes.label: Connector pins corroded - high contact resistance

P2DF7.title: Coolant Pump E Overspeed/Air in System
P2DF7.description: Coolant pump E reports a overspeed/air in system condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

P2DF8.title: Coolant Pump E Underspeed
P2DF8.description: Coolant pump E reports a underspeed condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

P2DF9.title: Coolant Pump E Stuck/Stalled
P2DF9.description: Coolant pump E reports a stuck/stalled condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

P2DFA.title: Coolant Pump E Supply Voltage Circuit
P2DFA.description: Coolant pump E reports a supply voltage circuit condition. Coolant circulation through the affected loop cannot be commanded reliably.

P2DFB.title: Coolant Pump E Control Module Overtemperature
P2DFB.description: The control module of coolant pump E reports junction temperature above the protection threshold.

P2DFC.title: Hybrid/EV Battery Coolant Leak Detected
P2DFC.description: The hybrid control module detects a coolant leak in the HV battery thermal loop. Coolant level dropping or leak sensor triggered.

causes.label: Pack cell imbalance approaching service threshold

symptoms: Reduced power output or limp mode
Charging may fail or be slowed

P2DFD.title: EVAP System Purge Pump Performance
P2DFD.description: The EVAP purge pump does not produce the expected flow during purge cycles. Pump aging, restricted line, or canister loaded.
symptoms: Possible smell of fuel near tank or engine bay
